events.evidence: Grocery inflation in the United Kingdom reaches a record high of 17.1%, according to market research group Kantar Worldpanel
A passenger train and a freight train collide in Tempi, Larissa, Thessaly, Greece, killing over 50 people and injuring more than 80 others
Finland begins construction of a border barrier on its border with Russia due to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine

label.note: Record UK grocery inflation and Greek train disaster weigh on sentiment; Finland-Russia border step.
